fact: The UDSM DHIS2 Lab states that Tanzania's HMIS data is captured at the point of service and entered into DHIS2 directly or at the district level, that DHIS2 datasets are assigned across about 9,000 health facilities in 184 district councils with users at district and facility level, and that use of DHIS2 has increased up to the facility level; it gives no count or share of facilities entering their own data and names no tier.
title: Decentralizing User Support in DHIS2: A Case of HMIS in Tanzania
